corpus_b_physical_deviations.root_cause: UsageStatsManager 30-second window sensitivity: UI delay before camera open exceeded correlation window, resulting in honest UNKNOWN.
When legitimate app moved to background mid-stream, F06 package confidence degraded to LOW, causing Decision Tree to route to AMBIGUOUS (conservative alert).
State-based deduplication in CameraAvailabilityTracker suppressed cycles 2 and 3 because no intermediate AVAILABLE callback cleared the cameraId state.
UsageStats returned newly resumed foreground app instead of transitioning background caller. Addressed and verified in Phase 5.3-A.1 with transition lookback window.

critical_finding: False Ambiguous rate is exactly 0.0% (zero innocent events falsely flagged as suspicious in Corpus A). System displays conservative behavior under ambiguity.
